text:
Noah (docs): FYI I opened PR #578 — small consolidation: batching defaults, KV-prefetch example, and a short-section on quant profiles for very short prompts. Could someone scan for SDK snippet parity? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/578

Ivy (eng): Linking. Quick scan: JS snippet still uses embed_model. Should be model: 'redwood/embed-1'. I'll push a tiny patch.

Marta R.: Thanks. Also noticed the Go example uses the old NewGenCall() API. Can someone paste the corrected snippet here for docs to verify?

Ivy (eng): Sure 609. Replace with builder pattern:```go
req := client.NewRequest().WithModel("redwood/opt-1").WithBatching(true)
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
``` Compiles in our harness.

Noah (docs): Great, I'll update the sample code block. Two editorial asks: 1) add a 1-line recommended defaults bullet for batching windows, 2) ensure the KV prefetch link is relative (we moved that cheatsheet).

Rao: Perf note from infra: interactive UIs: 20-30ms window recommended; batching windows >50ms show throughput regression on tail. Bulk/high-throughput jobs: 100-200ms. Adding numbers to PR comment.

Liam W.: On anchors: the qprofiles page renamed the short-seq anchor to #shortseq-profile, so the link in the PR 404s in preview. I'll push a redirect anchor and update the link to ./qprofiles.md#shortseq-profile.

DevBot: preview build started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/578. Link check: 2 broken -> /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet, qprofiles#short-sequence.

Noah (docs): Ivy, can you change the KV prefetch link to ./prefetch/cheatsheet.md#examples? That should fix it.

Ivy (eng): Done. Also updated JS embed snippet to use "model" instead of "embed_model". Pushed.

Marta R.: We also need a tiny note in the SDK migration guide: generation call now takes a request builder (client.Generate(ctx, req)) and batching config moved from ms int -> duration type. One sentence is enough.

Noah (docs): Drafted the migration blurb and added a minimal qprofile example for short prompts:```json
{"name":"shortseq-recommended","dtype":"fp16","notes":"prefer fp16 for <64 tokens; only enable 4-bit after regression tests"}
```

Rao: LGTM. One more suggestion: add a single YAML fallback example for routing when batching violates SLOs so readers see a concrete pattern.

Noah (docs): Added YAML sample:```yaml
routing:
  policy: prefer_low_latency
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-1-lite
      reason: slo_violation
``` 

DevBot: Re-run link check: 0 broken links. Build status: green. Lint: no warnings.

Liam W.: Approved. Can someone add a 1-line changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md summarizing: "Optimize: batching defaults, KV prefetch example, short-seq quant guidance, SDK migration notes"?

Noah (docs): I'll add the changelog and a translator note for the short-seq blurb. Merging once CI finishes. Thanks! :tada:

Ivy (eng): I'll follow up and update the sample apps to the new request builder API tomorrow.

Marta R.: Nice work, team. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
